title: rothmannia exaltata
intro: Rothmannia exaltata, commonly known as the Pride of India, is a flowering plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Rothmannia exaltata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are said to soothe digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Rothmannia exaltata include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
